item.text: The validator currently uses CUE’s aggregated error string, but only keeps each error’s first input position; unknown-field diagnostics therefore lose the nested field path. The JSON writer also encodes to process stdout instead of the supplied writer. I’m checking which CUE error metadata is available in this version and how to map schema errors back to the original YAML nodes.
